title: Infosys reports 6% Q2 net profit growth but trims full-year revenue outlook
summary: Infosys reported a 6% year-over-year increase in second-quarter net profit to ₹7,823 crore and declared an interim dividend of ₹26 per share. However, the company lowered its FY27 revenue growth guidance to 1%-2% due to weakness in discretionary IT spending.
point1: Infosys generated ₹7,823 crore in quarterly net profit and approved a ₹26 interim dividend.
point2: Full-year revenue growth guidance was cut to 1%-2% amid cautious client discretionary spending.

title: India to modify employment survey to capture gig workers and unpaid labor
summary: The Indian government will update the Periodic Labour Force Survey to include specific data on gig economy workers and unpaid domestic workers. The modification introduces new questions aimed at measuring nationwide labor underutilization.
point1: The revised survey will track participation in the gig economy and unpaid household work.
point2: The updates seek to provide a broader picture of labor utilization across the country.

title: Madhya Pradesh receives ₹15,400 crore investment proposals at semiconductor summit
summary: Chief Minister Mohan Yadav announced that Madhya Pradesh secured over ₹15,400 crore in investment proposals during a semiconductor industry summit. The state government noted that additional proposals worth ₹5,800 crore could generate approximately 10,000 regional jobs.
point1: Over ₹15,400 crore in semiconductor investment commitments were received by Madhya Pradesh.
point2: The proposals align with national efforts to build domestic semiconductor manufacturing capability.

title: IMD issues red alert as cyclonic storm approaches North Andhra Pradesh
summary: The India Meteorological Department announced that a cyclonic storm is likely to make landfall along the North Andhra Pradesh coast on October 28. Red warnings for extremely heavy rainfall were issued for October 27 and 28, and coastal fishermen were advised to return to land.
point1: Landfall along the North Andhra Pradesh coast is forecasted for October 28.
point2: Red alerts warn of severe rainfall risks and storm impacts in coastal areas.
point3: Extremely heavy rainfall warnings are in effect for October 27 and October 28.

title: Israel begins demolitions in Hebron following killing of two soldiers
summary: Israeli forces commenced the demolition of Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers were killed at a checkpoint outside the city. The soldiers were shot dead by two Palestinian gunmen on Friday morning.
point1: Two Israeli military personnel were killed in a shooting outside Hebron.
point2: Demolition operations represent an escalation in military operations in the West Bank.

title: Six Dead and 28 Injured in Gun Attack at Jordan Funeral
summary: Gunmen opened fire on mourners at a church funeral in Jordan's southern Karak governorate, leaving six people dead and 28 wounded. Jordanian security officials have launched a major manhunt to locate the attackers.
point1: Six people were killed and 28 injured in a church funeral shooting in Karak governorate.
point2: The incident represents a severe security breach in southern Jordan, prompting an immediate security response.
point3: A manhunt for the suspects is underway.

title: French Authorities Open Terrorism Investigation Into Fatal Shooting Near Paris
summary: French anti-terrorism prosecutors launched an investigation after one person was killed and five others were wounded in a shooting near Paris. Police confirmed that the suspected gunman has been apprehended.
point1: One person was killed and five were injured in a shooting attack outside Paris investigated as terrorism.
point2: Security measures in Paris have been heightened ahead of planned weekend public demonstrations.
point3: A law enforcement investigation into the suspect is ongoing.

title: Surge in Global Crude Oil Prices Pressures Indian Currency and Domestic Markets
summary: Global crude oil prices climbed near six-month highs following Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabian energy assets, raising India's crude import basket above $120. The spike contributed to a 12-paise drop in the Indian rupee to 94.93 per U.S. dollar and led to domestic fuel price increases.
point1: Brent crude reached intraday highs of $114.94 per barrel, raising India's monthly crude basket to $120.08.
point2: Escalating import costs impact India's current account deficit and trigger domestic inflationary pressures.

title: Quest Diagnostics Confirms Patient Data Compromised in Cyber Breach
summary: Laboratory testing firm Quest Diagnostics confirmed that patients' personal and medical health data was compromised during a security breach. The incident follows a broader trend of recent cyberattacks hitting healthcare technology organizations.
point1: Quest Diagnostics confirmed patient personal and health data was accessed in a security breach.
point2: Medical data breaches expose sensitive patient information and highlight vulnerabilities in critical healthcare infrastructure.

title: Typhoon Champi Strikes Taiwan, Grounding Hundreds of Flights
summary: Typhoon Champi caused widespread transport disruption and at least one fatality as it swept past Taiwan. Severe maritime conditions led to hundreds of cancelled flights, while authorities reported one person drowned on Liuqiu Island after being swept away by rough seas.
point1: Typhoon Champi forced the cancellation of hundreds of flights in Taiwan.
point2: One fatal casualty was confirmed on Liuqiu Island due to heavy wave action.

title: Polish PM Donald Tusk Calls for Commercial Joint Ventures on India Visit
summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk urged Indian and Polish businesses to convert bilateral strategic commitments into joint commercial ventures. Addressing the India-Poland Business Forum in Bengaluru, Tusk highlighted potential expansion in industrial and technology cooperation.
point1: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk spoke at the India-Poland Business Forum in Bengaluru.
point2: Tusk advocated moving beyond diplomatic agreements toward direct industrial and technological joint ventures.

title: State Bank of India Issues Direct Notifications to Data Breach Victims
summary: State Bank of India confirmed that it has sent individual notices to all customers impacted by a recently disclosed security breach. The direct outreach follows public criticism over the bank's initial decision to inform stock exchanges prior to notifying affected account holders.
point1: SBI completed direct notification to all individual customers affected by its cybersecurity breach.
point2: The move addresses privacy concerns and calls from digital rights groups for mandated breach disclosure windows.

title: Jio Platforms IPO Receives Global Record 1 Crore Applications
summary: Jio Platforms' $3.2 billion initial public offering has become the first stock issue globally to attract more than 1 crore individual applications. Bidding reached nearly seven times the available shares, with orders placed for over 147 crore shares against 19.75 crore offered.
point1: Jio Platforms set a global record by generating over 1 crore investor applications for its IPO.
point2: The overall offer was subscribed nearly 7 times during ongoing bidding for the $3.2 billion issue.

title: Health Officials Investigate Possible Ebola Exposure at Uganda Airport
summary: Health officials reported that Ebola patients from Nigeria and Kenya may have crossed paths at Entebbe International Airport in Uganda on October 3. The potential airport exposure has prompted expanded regional contact tracing.
point1: Ebola patients from two African nations were traced to the same Ugandan transit hub on October 3.
point2: International transit nodes present significant cross-border transmission risks during hemorrhagic fever outbreaks.
point3: Public health authorities are actively tracing contacts across affected flight routes.

title: India Calls for Urgent Structural Reform of UN Security Council
summary: India's Permanent Representative to the United Nations, Harish Parvathaneni, urged immediate reforms for the UN Security Council. Parvathaneni stated that the body struggles to maintain peace globally because its leadership structure has failed to evolve since 1945.
point1: Ambassador Harish Parvathaneni urged comprehensive structural reform of the UN Security Council.
point2: India continues its diplomatic push for permanent council representation for developing regions.

title: India Criticizes EU Carbon Tax on Steel as Economic Barrier
summary: Indian Union Minister Piyush Goyal criticized the European Union's proposed carbon tax on imported steel during an address in Berlin. Goyal warned that increasing regulatory burdens and border trade restrictions risk damaging global economic relations.
point1: Union Minister Piyush Goyal publicly opposed the EU's planned carbon border adjustment mechanisms on steel.
point2: The statement underlines growing international disputes over European carbon tariffs impacting developing exporters.

title: Trump Says Starlink Access Restored for Ukraine Military Use
summary: Donald Trump stated that Elon Musk has restored access to the Starlink satellite internet network in Ukraine. Ukrainian defense forces rely heavily on Starlink for battlefield communications and operational connectivity.
point1: Donald Trump stated that Starlink service access has been restored for Ukraine.
point2: Starlink provides key satellite communications infrastructure critical to Ukrainian military operations.

title: Critical PHP Vulnerabilities Spark Global Rush to Secure Web Systems
summary: Web developers and organization IT teams are racing to patch critical security flaws discovered in the PHP programming language. Security experts warn that the vulnerabilities are being broadly exploited across the internet, potentially impacting millions of websites.
point1: The PHP Foundation revealed critical vulnerabilities affecting web servers globally.
point2: Unpatched flaws allow remote cyberattacks, putting millions of active websites and online services at risk.
point3: Systems administrators are urgently applying newly issued security patches.

title: Adani Energy Solutions Q2 net profit doubles to ₹1,364 crore
summary: Adani Energy Solutions reported a more than two-fold increase in net profit for the second quarter, reaching ₹1,364 crore. The surge was driven by double-digit profit growth before tax in both its power transmission and distribution business segments.
point1: Adani Energy Solutions posted Q2 net profit of ₹1,364 crore, up significantly from the previous year.
point2: Pre-tax profits in the company's power transmission and distribution divisions rose 26.2% and 42.4% respectively.

title: SEBI cautions investors against fraudulent stock-tip WhatsApp schemes
summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) issued a public advisory warning investors against illegal stock-tip groups operating on messaging platforms like WhatsApp. The regulator highlighted the widespread use of "astroturfing"—where coordinated members post fake profit screenshots to deceive victims into making trades.
point1: SEBI warned investors about fraudulent WhatsApp channels promising stock recommendations and high returns.
point2: Regulators warned that bad actors use astroturfing tactics with fake gain statements to lure retail capital.
point3: SEBI advised the public to trade only through registered market intermediaries.

title: Trump ordered to testify under oath in BBC defamation lawsuit
summary: Donald Trump has been ordered by a court to answer questions under oath as part of his ongoing legal action against the BBC. The lawsuit stems from an episode of Panorama that edited together separate segments of a speech Trump delivered in 2021.
point1: A judge ruled that Donald Trump must give sworn testimony in his lawsuit against the BBC.
point2: The suit alleges defamation over how the BBC edited footage from a 2021 speech in a documentary broadcast.
point3: Deposition dates and court schedules are to be finalized by the involved legal teams.

title: Powerful earthquake in northeastern Tibet leaves at least 16 dead
summary: A powerful earthquake struck a mountainous region in northeastern Tibet, leaving at least 16 people dead according to official reports. Emergency response teams have been deployed to the sparsely populated area to evaluate damage and search for survivors.
point1: A high-magnitude earthquake hit northeastern Tibet, causing at least 16 confirmed fatalities.
point2: Rescue and assessment efforts are underway in the remote, mountainous impact zone.

title: RSF fighters deliberately targeting Sudan hospitals, BBC investigation finds
summary: A BBC investigation reveals that Rapid Support Forces (RSF) fighters in Sudan have deliberately targeted health facilities and medical workers across the country. UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk warned that the deliberate attacks on hospitals may constitute war crimes under international law.
point1: RSF forces in Sudan have systematically attacked hospitals and medical infrastructure.
point2: UN Human Rights Chief Volker Türk stated the attacks could amount to international war crimes.

title: Mark Zuckerberg agrees to stay in California under new Meta stock agreement
summary: Meta's board of directors has established a new stock class agreement to incentivize CEO Mark Zuckerberg to maintain his residency in California. The arrangement addresses board concerns over potential disruption to Meta's AI roadmap while providing Zuckerberg financial flexibility regarding California's proposed billionaire tax measure.
point1: Meta's board created a custom stock arrangement to incentivize Mark Zuckerberg to remain in California.
point2: The move aims to prevent leadership instability during Meta's ongoing AI investment cycle.
point3: The stock mechanism is tied to the potential passage of California's proposed billionaire wealth tax.

title: Hackers exploited critical PHP vulnerabilities days before patches were available
summary: Cybersecurity researchers and cloud providers report that two severe PHP vulnerabilities, known as PHP2Shell, were exploited across the internet prior to official fixes. Amazon Web Services logged exploitation attempts four days before patches were released by the PHP Foundation.
point1: Critical security flaws in the PHP programming language were actively exploited prior to patch availability.
point2: PHP powers millions of web servers globally, turning unpatched flaws into a major threat to web infrastructure.
point3: Organizations and cloud services are actively rushing to deploy patches.

title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
summary: OpenAI is reportedly working on a new $30 billion funding round that could value the artificial intelligence startup at $1.25 trillion. If completed at this valuation, it would make OpenAI the most highly valued private company in history.
point1: OpenAI is pursuing a $30 billion funding round at a $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of an expected initial public offering.
point2: A $1.25 trillion valuation would set a historical record for the highest valuation ever achieved by a private company.

title: Lula says rival should be disqualified over alleged Meta interference ahead of Brazil vote
summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva called for the disqualification of presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, citing alleged platform bias by Meta. Meta rejected the allegations of political intervention ahead of the upcoming election.
point1: President Lula accused Meta of favoring political candidate Flávio Bolsonaro in election algorithm distribution.
point2: Meta denied claims of political bias or interfering with content delivery ahead of the Brazilian vote.

title: Germany target of 'intensive' espionage, Merz says after suspected Russian spy arrest
summary: German political leader Friedrich Merz warned that Germany faces active foreign espionage following the detention of a suspected Russian spy. The arrest of a Ukrainian national suspected of intelligence gathering for Moscow is part of a series of recent counterespionage cases.
point1: German authorities arrested a Ukrainian national accused of spying on behalf of Russian intelligence.
point2: The incident prompted political warnings regarding intensified foreign intelligence operations inside Germany.

title: Paris extends curfew as Marseille and Lyon ban protests after riots
summary: French authorities extended a night-time curfew in Paris and issued protest bans in Marseille and Lyon following ongoing civil unrest. Public demonstrations are currently restricted to authorized union events, and major municipal venues will remain closed.
point1: Paris extended municipal curfews while Marseille and Lyon prohibited public protest gatherings.
point2: The government measures follow widespread street riots and public order disruptions across major French cities.
point3: Protest restrictions and venue closures remain scheduled through Saturday.

title: The RBI and its growing fiscal role
summary: The Reserve Bank of India transferred a record ₹2.87 lakh crore surplus to the Central government, underscoring its significant fiscal role. High returns from foreign asset management and reserve holdings contributed to the historic payout.
point1: The RBI completed a record ₹2.87 lakh crore surplus capital transfer to India's central government.
point2: The large transfer provides substantial fiscal revenue for government spending but prompts policy discussions on central bank autonomy.

title: eMudhra to exit overseas web security certificate business as stock takes beating
summary: Digital trust service provider eMudhra announced plans to exit its international web security certificate operations following a major security incident. The exposure of private keys associated with eight web security certificates impacted company stock value.
point1: eMudhra is unwinding its overseas web security certificate operations following a private key compromise.
point2: The security issue jeopardized certificate authenticity on older devices and triggered a decline in stock price.

title: Meta’s Ad Sales Are Suffering Now That Europeans Can Pick Less Personalization
summary: Meta reported a slowdown in European advertising revenue growth following regulatory changes to ad targeting options. The shift was driven by European Union mandates requiring platforms to offer less-personalized data tracking options.
point1: European ad sales growth decelerated following the introduction of Less-Personalized Ads controls.
point2: EU regulatory mandates allowing reduced user tracking directly impacted advertising performance.

title: Arc browser sunsets December 22 as The Browser Company doubles down on Dia
summary: The Browser Company announced that it will officially sunset its flagship Arc browser in December. The organization plans to reallocate its resources entirely toward developing its new browser application, Dia.
point1: The Browser Company will end support for the Arc browser on December 22.
point2: The team is shifting focus after Arc failed to achieve broad consumer market adoption.
point3: Arc will officially be sunset on December 22.

title: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work
summary: Uber is rolling out enterprise access to ChatGPT Work across its entire corporate workforce of 30,000 employees. The expansion follows an initial smaller pilot program conducted by the company.
point1: Uber expanded its enterprise AI agreement to cover all 30,000 corporate workers.
point2: The move represents one of the largest full-workforce enterprise deployments of OpenAI tools.

title: Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise
summary: A China-aligned cyber espionage group breached IT management provider ConnectWise to target thousands of downstream businesses. Microsoft reported that the attackers deployed autonomous AI agents to accelerate intrusion across client networks.
point1: Hackers compromised ConnectWise and leveraged autonomous AI agents to breach thousands of corporate targets rapidly.
point2: The attack highlights the increasing deployment of automated AI systems by state-aligned threat actors.

title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions
summary: Chinese AI company DeepSeek has reportedly raised $15 billion in a major funding round. The investment comes shortly after U.S. federal agencies were ordered to remove its technology due to national security concerns.
point1: DeepSeek secured $15 billion in one of China's largest technology funding rounds to date.
point2: The capital injection follows severe regulatory restrictions imposed by the U.S. government.

title: Tesla reports 43% profit drop as Optimus robot production begins in California
summary: Tesla reported flat revenue and a 43% decline in quarterly net profit due to rising costs in its artificial intelligence and autonomous programs. The automaker confirmed that production of its Optimus humanoid robot has begun in California.
point1: Tesla's third-quarter net income fell 43% as operating expenses jumped across AI and vehicle development.
point2: Initial production of the Optimus robot has formally commenced at the company's California facility.

title: Jio Platforms' ₹30,213-crore IPO sees bids jump 4x on second day
summary: Jio Platforms Ltd's ₹30,213-crore initial public offering was oversubscribed four times on its second day of bidding. The retail portion of the issue was completely filled within 100 minutes of opening on October 21.
point1: Total bids reached four times the total offered shares on day two of the ₹30,213-crore initial public offering.
point2: Retail investors fully subscribed their designated allotment shortly after the issue launched.

title: State Bank of India details customer data exposure following CERT-In and agency alerts
summary: State Bank of India confirmed in a stock exchange filing that it experienced a data security incident involving exposed customer information. The bank was alerted by its Threat Intelligence Service Provider, the Defence Cyber Agency, and CERT-In after customer data was detected on the dark web.
point1: SBI received notifications from CERT-In and the Defence Cyber Agency on October 16 regarding customer data exposure on the dark web.
point2: The exposure puts cyber defenses at India's largest lender under intense regulatory and public oversight.
point3: SBI plans to have a fully operational Cyber Defence Centre by FY27.

title: Houthi missile attack on eastern Saudi airport sparks oil price surge
summary: Authorities in Saudi Arabia reported two deaths following an attack on an airport in the eastern part of the country by Houthi forces. The strike sent Brent crude oil futures rising over 3% to near six-month highs due to supply disruption fears.
point1: Two people were killed in an attack targeting an airport in eastern Saudi Arabia.
point2: Brent crude futures increased by 3.2% to $112.35 per barrel following concerns over regional supply stability.

title: Startup Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model built via AI self-improvement
summary: AI startup Recursive released Flint, a free, lightweight coding model capable of running locally on personal laptops. The company built the model primarily through its automated AI research platform, serving as an early test of recursive self-improvement.
point1: Recursive released Flint, a free laptop-sized AI coding model.
point2: The model was constructed largely by Recursive's internal AI research system in an exercise of recursive self-improvement.

title: Nvidia launches DSX Pod modular system for 14-day AI data center deployment
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang unveiled the DSX Pod modular system to speed up AI data center installation across Europe and worldwide. By shifting testing and assembly to factories, Nvidia aims to compress deployment timelines at prepared sites from several months down to 14 days.
point1: Nvidia introduced the DSX Pod modular system to accelerate AI hardware deployment.
point2: The design aims to reduce site setup timelines from months to 14 days by pre-assembling components in factories.

title: Critical PHP security vulnerabilities expose millions of websites to attack
summary: Security researchers at OpenAI and Google's Wiz discovered two critical vulnerabilities in the PHP programming language that put millions of websites at risk. The PHP Foundation has disclosed the flaws and cybersecurity experts are calling for urgent system updates.
point1: Two severe flaws discovered in PHP impact millions of active websites.
point2: Failure to patch the underlying code leaves web servers vulnerable to remote compromise.
point3: Cybersecurity organizations urge system administrators to apply patches immediately.

title: Tesla plans Cybercab sales by year-end as Q3 profits fall 43%
summary: Tesla announced plans to begin selling its autonomous Cybercab to customers by the end of the year, even as federal safety regulators evaluate the vehicle's design. The announcement coincided with third-quarter earnings showing flat revenue and a 43% drop in profits due to heavy spending on AI, robotics, and autonomous driving.
point1: Tesla intends to initiate commercial sales of its control-less Cybercab before year-end.
point2: Quarterly profits dropped 43% as expenses surged for Optimus production and self-driving technology.
point3: Tesla targets Cybercab customer availability by the end of 2026.

title: Kuki-Zo community groups demand reimposition of President’s Rule in Manipur
summary: Kuki-Zo organizations in Manipur have called for the reimposition of President's Rule in the state to address ongoing ethnic violence and political instability. Community leaders stated that 32 members have died in clashes since March, while severe economic embargoes continue to disrupt local livelihoods.
point1: Kuki-Zo groups formally petitioned the government to restore President's Rule in Manipur.
point2: Leaders cited 32 community deaths since March and ongoing economic blockades affecting local villages.

title: RBI Monetary Policy Committee warns of broadening inflation risks
summary: Minutes from the Reserve Bank of India’s Monetary Policy Committee meeting indicate growing concern over inflationary pressures extending beyond food and fuel. The central bank governor warned that interest rate hikes remain possible if price pressures persist, though two panel members dissented against a hawkish stance.
point1: RBI committee minutes warn that inflation is spreading into broader economic sectors.
point2: The RBI governor raised the prospect of rate hikes while two panel members advocated a less hawkish position.

title: India's core industrial growth reaches record 7.9% in September 2026
summary: India's Index of Core Industries expanded by 7.9% in September 2026, marking the highest growth rate since the current series was introduced in April 2024. The acceleration was propelled by a 13-month high in coal production alongside strong performance in refinery products and iron ore.
point1: India's core sector output grew 7.9% year-on-year in September 2026.
point2: The surge was led by strong output in coal, petroleum refinery products, and iron ore.

title: Pope Francis requires no further treatment following localized lung cancer surgery
summary: Medical diagnostic tests confirmed that Pope Francis was treated for a localized lung adenocarcinoma following surgery. Doctors determined that the tumor was entirely contained and that the pontiff will not require additional medical treatment.
point1: Post-surgery test results confirmed Pope Francis was diagnosed with a localized lung adenocarcinoma.
point2: Medical staff confirmed the cancer was localized and fully addressed by the surgical procedure.

title: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion over user data privacy violations
summary: Meta has been ordered to pay a $25 billion penalty in connection with a trial focused on its data privacy practices. The judgment marks the largest financial penalty levied against the social media giant to date.
point1: A court ordered Meta to pay $25 billion over misrepresentations regarding user data privacy.
point2: The ruling stems from legal proceedings linked to the Cambridge Analytica data privacy scandal.

title: Russia agrees in principle to Ukraine peace talks as missiles strike Kyiv
summary: Moscow announced it is ready in principle to resume peace negotiations with Ukraine following diplomatic efforts from the United States. However, Russian missile strikes hit Kyiv shortly after the announcement, highlighting ongoing hostilities.
point1: Russia expressed willingness in principle to resume peace talks after U.S. diplomatic intervention.
point2: The diplomatic announcement coincided with renewed Russian missile strikes hitting the Ukrainian capital.
